                          Craik Dst., Sask. 94-01-09

                This report is being submitted as per Operational Manual I.3.E.7.a.

                On 94-01-08 at about 1730 hours          observed a fireball in the sky near
                her residence at Craik.                                               She
                described seeing a bright fiery object in the sky which was trailing thick
                black smoke. The object was observed on an approximate heading of 40°
                magnetic (54° true) from the Sask Tel tower located at N51°03'20''Wl05°51'50''.
                The sighting lasted for 5 - 8 seconds and was not witnessed by anyone else.
                        indicated the object was zigzagging through the sky. She heard no
                noise because she was in her home looking out the dining room window at the
                time. The object steadily descended toward the earth.

        •       No other reports of similar sighting> were received by this office or any other
        I

                surrounding Detachments.          initially felt it may have been an airplane
                in trouble. She watched it land on the horizon and did not observe any
                explosion.
                            Vehicle access to the area where this object went down is not
                practical. While           els the object was only.
                                                                    7 - 10 kms. away, it may
                well have been more as distances are hard to estimate in this area.

                Yours truly,

     1. CIRVIS
    2. CFM**
    3. UFO
    CFM** BE18 DEPARTED Y** NE BOUND AT 0050Z. AT APRX 0105Z HE REPORTED AN
    AIRCRAFT 1/2 MILE OFF HIS WING JUST BELOW HIM, FM** AT 075. AFTER A MOMENT
    HE REPORTED THAT IT IS NOT AN AIRCRAFT BUT SOMETHING BOWL SHAPED, BROWN
    AND ORANGE WITH DARKER SPOTS IN THE CENTRE. OBJECT NOW LEVEL WITH HIM AND
    KEEPING PACE. HE CHANGED HIS COURSE AND SO DID THE OBJECT. OBJECT CAME
    WITHIN 300 YARDS. CFM** CHANGED BACK TO HIS ORIGINAL HEADING 073, OBJECT
    FOLLOWED. OBJECT DESCRIBED AS CURVED TOP AND BOTTOM SLOPING TO A RIM.
    AFTER A MOMENT THE OBJECT DROPPED BACK AND DIVED TO THE GROUND. FM**
    REPORTED THE OBJECT NO LONGER IN SIGHT. WILL REPORT IF HE SEES IT AGAIN
    BUT HE DOESN'T WANT TO SEE IT AGAIN. PILOT ALONE AND SHAKEN.
    UNFORTUNATELY, NO OTHER WITNESSES WE KNOW OF.
    4. APRX 15 ?? NE Y** AT 075
    5. 9402270105
    6. 075(SCATTERED)
    7. NE
    8. UNKNOWN
    9. SEE ABOVE DESCRIPTION
    THUNDER BAY FSS                               •




    --------------------------------------------------------------
                                                                      •


    NOTE: I have discussed this incident with the pilot (who is quite
    experienced and in his mid 40's) and have no reason to doubt that the
    events took place as described to me. Although not shown on this CIRVIS
    report (and I don't think this was reported to the authorities), the pilot
    had two sightings on consecutive nights, and on one night saw two separate
    objects ... the one which dived to the ground, and another at an altitude
    of approx 30,000 feet. The objects had lights which appeared to be
    pulsating in response to each other. He lost sight of the one on the
    ground and the object at 30,000 feet shot across the sky at high speed and
    disappeared. In addition, during one of the sightings the pilot
    experienced "time distortion" (as he put it) for a period he feels lasted
    about 15 minutes.

        Dear Sir/Madame,


        On 94-06-07 Gimli, Manitoba R.C.M.P. Detachment received a report
        of a U.F.O. sighting that occurred at approximately 03:30 hrs.
        this date. The sighting occurred approximately two miles north
        and three and one half miles west of the Town of Gimli, Manitoba.
        Two persons saw the object for approximately three minutes.   They
•
        saw a large donut shaped object that they estimated to be between
        three hundred and four hundred feet in diameter. The object was
        white light in color and had between nine and twelve flashing
        and/or pulsatinglights running evenly around its circumference.
        The persons estimated it to be between five hundred and fifteen
        hundred feet in altitude and it was flying in an easterly direction
        (towards Lake Winnipeg).  They said the object was slow moving and
        described it as being moderate in brightness.  The sky was partly
        cloudy at the time of the sightipg.
                                           I

                                      , who live
        Rural Municipality of Girnli, Manitoba.

        This report is forwarded for your information.  If you have any
        questions please contact the undersigned at (204)642-5104.  Thank-
        you.


        Yours truly,

       BC-CANADA-METEORITE
        EXPLOSION ROCKS MONTREAL, POLICE SAY WAS METEORITE
           MONTREAL JUNE 13 (REUTER) - AN EXPLOSION THAT WAS LIKELY CAUSED
       BY A METEORITE SHOOK THE MONTtlEAL AREA TUESDAY NIGHT BUT APPARENTLY
       CAUSED NO INJURIES POLICE SAID.
           ''A NUMBER OP PEOPLE HAVE CALLED TO TELL US ABOUT AN EXPLOSION
       THAT WAS FELT ON THE SOUTH SHORE (ACROSS THE ST LAWRENCE RIVER FROM
       MONTREAL),'' A MONTREAL POLICE SPOKESMAN SAID. ''WE THINK IT WAS A
       METEORITE THAT IN ALL PROBABILITY LANDED IN A FIELD.''
           UNIVERSITY OF MONTREAL SEISMOLOGIST MANELLA SALVATORE SAID THE
       EXPLOSION THAT OCCURRED ABOUT 8:30 P.M. EDT {0030 GMT WEDNESDAY) MAY
       HAVE BEEN A METEORITE, BUT WAS DEFINITELY NO't AN EARTHQUAl<E, THE
       CANADIAN PRESS NEWS AGENCY REPORTED.
           SALVATORE SAID THE BLAST REGISTERED 3.8 ON THE RICHTER SCALE AT
       ITS EPICENTRE NEAR STE-JULIE EAST OF MONTREAL.
           THE MON'rREAL POLICE SPOKESMAN SAID PEOPLE IN THE EAST END OF
       MONTREAL SAID THEY SAW A BALL OF FIRE IN THB SKY. ''THAT MEANS IT'S
       ONE OF TWO THINGS -- A METEORITE OR AN AIRPLANE. AND (THE AIRPORT)
       SAYS ALL AIRPLANES ARE ACCOUNTED FOR.''
           A SPOKESWOMAN FOR THE PROVINCIAL SURETE DU QUEBEC SAID THE POLICE
       HAD RECEIVED MANY CALLS ABOUT THE EXPLOSION, BUT NONE REPORTING ANY
       INJURIES OR PROPERTY DAMAGE.

                    Dear Sir/Madam:

                    RE:        POSSIBLE U.F.O. SIGHTING
                               RED DEER, ALBERT A
                               94 JUL 15 @ 0220 HOURS


                    On 94 JUL 15 at 1605 hours, Red Deer City R.C.M.P. received a report of a sighting of an
                    unidentified flying object.

                                           and a friend,                  , reported that at 0220 hours on 94 mL
                    15, they observ·ed an object (shaped ike a plane) travel at a high rate of speed across the sky
                    above Red Deer.

                    There was no sound coming from the object and there were no lights being displayed. The
                    object had a reddish glow about it as it travelled in a straight line from the north east to the
                    south west. The sighting lasted approximately one to three minutes. The sky was clear and
                    dark and it was difficult to estimate the altitude.

   5 December 1994

   POSSIBLE METEORITE SIQ~_1ING_REPORT
   At 2334Z this evening, three aircraft (one at Val D'Or
   flight level 200 heading north, one at Mirable flight level
   200 heading north, and one in the l~nding pattern at
   Metaga.mi) reported seeing a bright light overhead followed
   by an explosion. The aircraft at Metagami also reported
   seeing pieces falling after the explosion.       .
   The reports were passed to Montreal Centre and Trenton
   Rescua Coordination Centre. Th~ reports were passed to
   Canadian NOR.An Region, who then advised the National Defence
   Operations Centre.
   Canadian NORAD Region conf itttted r.hat no accidents were
   reported, and that U.S. Space Command and NORAD Headquarters
   in Cheyenne Mountain had no inf orrnation regarding the
   sightings.
